title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
summary: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。
summaryEn: Starting from the forces that drive rain through a façade and the conversion of wind pressure, explain pressure-equalised rainscreens, air barriers and capillarity at joints, then turn design pressure into the test pressures and acceptance values of ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, covering mock-up testing, field sampling during installation and the time budget of AAMA 501.2 hose testing, and close with leak diagnosis, post-event re-testing and handover records, using Taipei 101, MIT's Stata Center and the British Columbia leaky-condo crisis to show what testing and design errors cost.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
architectureNodes: 漏水紀錄與事件後複驗

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」與「壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" and "Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風壓驅動水頭」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind-driven water head” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。颱風時迎風面外部壓力高於室內，壓差會把附著在接縫上的水「吸」進牆內，甚至推過排水槽的擋水高度。因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風壓驅動水頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside. In a typhoon the windward exterior pressure exceeds the interior, and the difference draws water clinging to joints into the wall or even pushes it over the dam of a drainage channel. Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind-driven water head” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風壓驅動水頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind-driven water head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓
knowledge.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure
knowledge.text: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。
knowledge.textEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" is correct?
options: 外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。
雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。
雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。
optionsEn: A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant.
For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it.
Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better.
quiz.explanation: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風壓驅動水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind-driven water head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。V = 30 m/s、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、ΔCp = 1.2：ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa，相當於水柱高 h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm；排水槽擋水高度若只有 40 mm，水就可能被推過。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. With V = 30 m/s, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and ΔCp = 1.2: ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa, equivalent to a water column of h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm; a drainage-channel dam only 40 mm high can be overtopped. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。V = 30 m/s、ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、ΔCp = 1.2：ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa，相當於水柱高 h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm；排水槽擋水高度若只有 40 mm，水就可能被推過。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. With V = 30 m/s, ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and ΔCp = 1.2: ΔP = 0.5×1.2×30²×1.2 = 648 Pa, equivalent to a water column of h = ΔP/(ρ_w·g) = 648/9,810 ≈ 66 mm; a drainage-channel dam only 40 mm high can be overtopped. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure", which statement holds?
options: 接縫縫隙做得越小，雨水就越不會滲入牆內。
現場試驗的壓力比實驗室低，所以現場試驗只是形式。
風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。
optionsEn: The narrower a joint gap is made, the less rain can get into the wall.
Field tests use lower pressure than the laboratory, so they are a mere formality.
Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp.
quiz.explanation: 風壓差 ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind pressure difference ΔP = ½·ρ·V²·ΔCp. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風壓驅動水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind-driven water head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure"?
options: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
現場用水管噴水不漏，就證明外牆在颱風中也不會漏。
optionsEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a façade does not leak under a site hose, it will not leak in a typhoon either.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞試驗或規範的局部外牆壓力係數求得各區設計風壓，換算成水密試驗壓力與擋水高度需求；檢查設計圖中每一處窗台、橫框與上下單元接縫的擋水高度是否大於試驗壓力對應的水柱高，並在樣品牆試驗中觀察水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain zone design pressures from wind-tunnel tests or code local cladding coefficients, convert them into water-test pressures and required dam heights; check that every sill, transom and stack joint on the drawings has a dam higher than the water column equivalent to the test pressure, and observe water levels during the mock-up test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風壓驅動水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind-driven water head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外牆會漏水，一定是因為密封膠品質不好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A leaking façade must have poor-quality sealant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「壓力等化腔體」如何影響建築外牆氣密水密試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-equalised cavity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Facade air- and water-tightness testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 壓力等化雨幕把外牆分成兩道防線：外側的雨幕擋住大部分雨水，但刻意留有通氣開口；內側的空氣屏障則必須連續且氣密。當外部風壓變化時，空氣經由通氣開口進入兩道防線之間的腔體，使腔體壓力接近外部壓力，雨幕兩側的壓差就很小，水不再被壓差推過外層接縫；真正承受壓差的是乾燥的內側空氣屏障。若空氣屏障漏氣，腔體壓力就無法建立，等化失效。英屬哥倫比亞沿海在 1990 年代大量出現的漏水公寓，調查即指出過度依賴「單層表面密封」的牆體是主因之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「壓力等化腔體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pressure-equalised rainscreen divides the wall into two lines of defence: an outer rainscreen that stops most rain but deliberately has vents, and an inner air barrier that must be continuous and airtight. As exterior pressure changes, air flows through the vents into the cavity between them, bringing cavity pressure close to the exterior so that the pressure difference across the rainscreen is small and water is no longer pushed through its joints; the dry inner air barrier takes the pressure difference. If the air barrier leaks, cavity pressure cannot build and equalisation fails. Investigations into the leaky condominiums of coastal British Columbia in the 1990s identified reliance on face-sealed walls as a main cause. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pressure-equalised cavity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「壓力等化腔體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pressure-equalised cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力等化腔體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-equalised cavity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。通氣面積為屏障洩漏面積 10 倍時，雨幕只承受 1/101 ≈ 1% 的壓差；只有 5 倍時約 3.8%。若屏障洩漏增加使比值降為 2，雨幕承受 20%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]. With vent area 10 times the barrier leakage area the rainscreen sees only 1/101 ≈ 1% of the pressure difference; at 5 times about 3.8%. If barrier leakage grows so the ratio falls to 2, the rainscreen sees 20%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 通氣口與空氣屏障洩漏可視為串聯孔口：A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l，故 ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]。通氣面積為屏障洩漏面積 10 倍時，雨幕只承受 1/101 ≈ 1% 的壓差；只有 5 倍時約 3.8%。若屏障洩漏增加使比值降為 2，雨幕承受 20%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vents and air-barrier leakage act as orifices in series: A_v·√ΔP_v = A_l·√ΔP_l, so ΔP_v/ΔP = 1/[1 + (A_v/A_l)²]. With vent area 10 times the barrier leakage area the rainscreen sees only 1/101 ≈ 1% of the pressure difference; at 5 times about 3.8%. If barrier leakage grows so the ratio falls to 2, the rainscreen sees 20%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A passed mock-up proves that every panel on site will be watertight.
The airflow read on the meter is the façade's leakage.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力等化腔體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-equalised cavity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Façade drawings should trace the continuous air-barrier line in colour or linetype, including its connections to slabs, roof, ground and adjacent systems; cavity compartments and vent positions are confirmed in shop drawings and the mock-up, and any break in the air barrier needs the façade consultant's approved remedy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在樣品牆腔體內與內外側設壓力計，於靜壓與動壓試驗時同步記錄，確認腔體壓力能跟上外部壓力變化；以氣密試驗確認空氣屏障的洩漏量，並檢查通氣口與腔體分隔是否依設計配置，避免不同壓力區的腔體互相連通。
knowledge.textEn: Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure; confirm air-barrier leakage by air testing, and check that vents and cavity compartments follow the design so that cavities in different pressure zones are not connected.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。
knowledge.textEn: Façade drawings should trace the continuous air-barrier line in colour or linetype, including its connections to slabs, roof, ground and adjacent systems; cavity compartments and vent positions are confirmed in shop drawings and the mock-up, and any break in the air barrier needs the façade consultant's approved remedy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Fit pressure taps in the mock-up cavity and on both faces, logging them together during static and dynamic tests to confirm that cavity pressure follows exterior pressure.
Sealing the spot where water appears indoors fixes the façade leak.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力等化腔體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-equalised cavity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：英屬哥倫比亞沿海在 1990 年代大量出現的漏水公寓，調查即指出過度依賴「單層表面密封」的牆體是主因之一。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Investigations into the leaky condominiums of coastal British Columbia in the 1990s identified reliance on face-sealed walls as a main cause.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雨幕的通氣開口會讓雨水進入，所以封得越密越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rainscreen vents let rain in, so the tighter the outer layer is sealed the better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 腔體在轉角處沒有分隔，迎風面與側風面的腔體相通，空氣在腔體內橫向流動，迎風面腔體壓力永遠追不上外部，雨水被推過外層接縫；空氣屏障在樓板邊緣不連續，等化系統徒具形式。
knowledge.textEn: Without compartment closures at corners, windward and side cavities connect and air flows sideways inside them, so the windward cavity never reaches exterior pressure and rain is pushed through the outer joints; an air barrier discontinuous at slab edges reduces the equalisation system to a formality.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力等化雨幕與空氣屏障」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-equalised rainscreens and the air barrier" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
